name: eve-cyno
description: EVE Online data tools over MCP: fit validation and stats, ship and module facts, live Jita prices and ESI reads, industry, routes. No API key needed for the public tools; a free key adds community fits and battle reports.

api_key.title: EVE-Cyno API key (optional)
api_key.description: A free key adds get_fits, list_fits and analyze_battle and doubles the per-minute limits. Get one with /apikey create in the EVE-Cyno Discord or at ai.eve-cyno.dev (Settings, Data API keys). Leave empty to use the public tools only. Sent only to data.eve-cyno.dev, in the X-API-Key header.

janice_api_key.title: Janice API key (optional)
janice_api_key.description: Your own Janice key (janice.e-351.com) for item appraisals with appraise_items. Leave empty to skip; everything else works without it. Sent only to data.eve-cyno.dev, which forwards it to Janice for that one request and never stores or logs it.
